title: Weather, Not Climate
subtitle: Emotional context dynamics in transformer KV-cache geometry: contrast effects, uncertainty scars, and dose-dependent decay
abstract: Emotion read from single-turn KV keys does not cumulatively accumulate across conversation turns (the single-turn result this builds on is under correction: a story-emotion decode from KV keys at 12.3x chance, not W_K and not user state; valence 0.992 = n=300, arousal-confounded). Instead, emotional context shows contrast dynamics (overshoot at tone shifts), residual uncertainty scars, and dose-dependent decay. System prompts set emotional climate; conversation history provides weather with contrast at fronts.
